title: Even Trees Know Sorrow - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: Even Trees Know Sorrow trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: Even Trees Know Sorrow phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Missable. The third of the three silver quest trophies and the easiest to leave until too late, because the Banyan area stops being reachable.

sections.title: How to Earn
sections.content: Complete the side quest Heart of the Banyan.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 19 of 36 on the list - before it Phantom and Blade · after it The Last of Baishan. It is missable, and the checklist of everything that expires is on the guide. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
